candidates.cluster_label: Maran Gas Maritime — Maran Gas Efessos, 159,800 cbm DFDE membrane carrier, Hanwha Ocean (ex-DSME), delivered 2014
candidates.discovery_notes: Found by the IGU fleet-table completeness check, not by a date window: IMO 9627497 appears in BOTH IGU World LNG Report 2025 and 2026 Appendix 3 (fleet) and in no backend row — by IMO or by name. The backend was seeded from IGU 2025, so this is a seeding gap, not a new vessel: sister ships Maran Gas Delphi (sheet 343), Lindos (376), Mystras (377) and Troy (379) are all present, all 159,800 cbm / DFDE / membrane / Hanwha Ocean, and all cite the IGU 2025 landing page. Efessos's IMO (9627497) is adjacent to Lindos's (9627502). Every value here is what IGU 2026 prints for this IMO (igu_refs.corroborates_cell, keyed on the IMO, IG SOP §1), corroborated where shipvault's unit record agrees. Name: checked against the database first per the 2026-09-21 rule — shipvault's record for IMO 9627497 reads 'Maran Gas Efessos' too, so IGU's name is not in dispute and nothing goes to Other names. Shipbuilder cites IGU alone: the shipvault page says 'Daewoo'/'Okpo' (the pre-2023 yard name) and so cannot corroborate the backend's controlled value 'Hanwha Ocean'. Cargo type, Vessel type and Propulsion type likewise cite IGU alone — shipvault's record states none of them. Hull number 2291 is from shipvault; IGU prints no hull column, and the four sister rows leave the cell blank, so this one cell is additive beyond the sibling pattern. Contract date omitted: no source states one.
